[DESCRIPTION]: The function f(x) takes a string input and returns the string reversed — character by character (by Unicode code points). It performs no case changes, no trimming, and works on arbitrary characters including whitespace, digits, punctuation, and Unicode. Empty strings return empty.

def f(x: str) -> str:
    return x[::-1]
